_comment: Per-week progress reports for the Gantt detail panel. Hand-edit this file. Keys are week numbers (strings) matching the Gantt's W0..W12. Each week has three sections: planned (set at the start of the week), refactored (mid-week scope changes / re-plans), accomplished (what actually got done). Items are plain strings, or { name, status } where status is 'todo' | 'done'.

4.label: MVP Phase 1 — Music Genre (BEARDOWN)
planned: EDA + standalone site design — Music Genre
Music Genre experimental design [a, b, c]
Standalone site: run sweeps, model lock, drop-in analysis
refactored: Genre became the reference implementation: the full BEARDOWN-depth treatment here defines the standalone-site template that phonon (W5) and ATLAS (W6) copy \u2014 so genre absorbed extra build time up front to de-risk models 2 and 3.

“Min. Bayesian options (LLLA + HMC)” split into two stages: W4 staged the bundle for it (cached phi_train.npy + ggn_eig.npz so the head is plug-ready); the LLLA/HMC math + observatory tab itself landed at the W4\u2192W5 boundary (2026-06-22).
accomplished: BEARDOWN Model 1 up as a local full-stack standalone site — EDA \u2192 leakage-safe data \u2192 frozen backbone \u2192 drop-in inference \u2192 Flask dashboard (tabs: EDA / experiment / model / data / glossary)
Leakage-safe data pipeline built: track-level vs naive split + BEARDOWN stratified seed-42 reproduction; clean log-mel @128 \u22c8 57-feature tabular; naive-vs-track gap captured as a result
Architecture vetted bit-faithful against the public INFO_510 repo (cfg_14: gated fusion, deterministic head, 573,450 params) — zero mechanism mismatch for the FORGE det-backbone + LLLA plan
Clean log-mel regeneration fixed the silent dirty-grey failure: train + inference now share one extract_mel recipe (validate r=1.0), so dropped songs no longer score as noise
Backbone frozen at clean-128 / batch-8: batch 32\u21928 lifted CV +0.086; frozen draw = val 0.7467 / test 0.700 / macro-F1 0.686 (573,450 params, bundle round-trips bit-exact)

Gap-to-0.766 fully diagnosed — early-stop, epochs/lr, representation, split, and resolution all ruled out; lever was batch size, residual is framework + run variance. Decision: freeze, don’t chase 0.766 (the ~0.71 wall is FORGE’s motivating example, not a bug)

Song drop-in inference verified end-to-end on wav + mp3: 30-s windows \u2192 mel + 57 feats \u2192 per-genre prob + MC-dropout σ; load_audio hardened (soundfile \u2192 librosa fallback \u2192 clear error)
7-file frozen bundle shipped (weights / arch / scaler / label_map / phi_train.npy / ggn_eig.npz / metrics) — phi_train + GGN eigendecomp pre-staged so the Bayesian head is plug-ready
ML usage / cost ledger built (_shared/usage.py): per-run compute.json \u2192 energy / carbon / $ with measured-vs-modeled tags; rolls up all 11 runs (~0.33 h wall, ~14.8 Wh modeled-TDP)

5.label: MVP Phase 1 — Phonon
planned: Standalone site: run sweeps, model lock, drop-in analysis
refactored: Behind schedule entering W5. Pivot: build phonon as a stripped-down / more basic design first \u2014 get model 2 standing on the standalone template, then deepen \u2014 rather than the full BEARDOWN-depth treatment up front.

Genre proved the full-stack template (EDA \u2192 data \u2192 frozen model \u2192 inference \u2192 dashboard); phonon copies the skeleton and fills only the three domain pieces (data adapter, EDA, features/model/config) to hit the “get it running” floor.

Still in flux across all three models: model 2 (phonon) and model 3 (ATLAS) are scaffold-only (skeleton repos, no data/runs yet), and the unified FORGE layout / metrics view is still being designed \u2014 the per-model dashboards will converge on one shared FORGE look in Phase 2.

accomplished.name: FORGE Bayesian core landed for genre (carry-over from W4): LLLA last-layer Laplace + HMC gold-standard sampler on the frozen head, plus the observatory tab (overview / posterior / model / τ-sweep / eigenspectrum / data-frac / report / HMC)

Headline finding wired into the FORGE report: ~506/512 last-layer weight-directions are prior-led \u2192 model is data-limited, not capacity-limited (answers “can it go further, or is it noise-capped?”)
Phonon — data adapter + domain EDA + features/model/config filled into the skeleton
